package ledger
namespace record_surface
import 규칙 "example/rules"

entity Invoice id "urn:record-format:invoice" fields {
    field caption id "urn:record-format:caption" type "urn:gooo:type:string" required one
    field approved id "urn:record-format:approved" type "urn:gooo:type:boolean" required one
    field discount id "urn:record-format:discount" type "urn:gooo:type:integer" optional one
}
activity Capture(Invoice) -> Invoice id "urn:record-format:capture" computes "return input"
activity Store(Invoice) -> Invoice id "urn:record-format:store" computes "// source body remains literal\nreturn input"
bind Capture.result -> Store.input
